cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ov_tracking_checks LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(OpenCV 4 REQUIRED COMPONENTS core calib3d)
add_executable(geometric_verification test_geometric_verification.cpp)
target_include_directories(geometric_verification PRIVATE ../src ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(geometric_verification PRIVATE ${OpenCV_LIBS})
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME failed_klt_points_do_not_enter_geometric_consensus COMMAND geometric_verification)
